dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: It's time for school. You're going to be late.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Yes honey. It's the first day, you can't miss it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: I'm sorry, I didn't have time to pack you lunch. But I put some money in your account. That should work.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: I have to go now, but don't dwaddle, okay? Bus comes in 20.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Love you too, sweetie. Get going.
